text: Winamax's own company page names its founders, Alexandre Roos and Christophe Schaming, as its shareholders; the company is WINAMAX SA, RCS Paris 492 155 932. The company register lists it as a société anonyme with a board of directors, chaired by Alexandre Roos, who is also its chief executive.
short: Winamax names its founders Alexandre Roos and Christophe Schaming as its shareholders

source.name: Winamax — À propos de Winamax
source.quote: Ses actionnaires et fondateurs, Alexandre Roos, Christophe Schaming (Lycos, Caramail), ont associé leur savoir-faire autour de l’internet communautaire et de l’industrie du jeu en ligne.
